name: terminal-continuation-hold

graded_by.test: owed: recording_continuation_terminal_continuation_hold_u3: held-session ring proof with control and heartbeats connected
owed: recording_continuation_terminal_continuation_hold_u2: suppress redial and isolate the held session

description: A held session closes only its data peer while control and heartbeats remain connected. The worker continues reading into the bounded drop-oldest ring; on restart hello_ack exposes its replay boundary. U3 must prove this before reliance.

doc.scenario: held session ring under live control
steps: for every supported recorded PTY worker version open a session
keep the control peer and heartbeats connected
close only its data peer and write output exceeding the ring capacity
expect: the ring retains the newest bytes using drop-oldest
hello reports the correct first buffered seq and offset
